title: Membership Tenure Credit for Grocery Order Service-Fee Share Refunds
content:
# Membership tenure credit for Cartwise Grocery Orders service-fee share refunds

Training note on how the length of a customer's Cartwise+ Membership bears on a service-fee share refund.

**Rule.** When the Cartwise+ Membership recorded on the order was enrolled at least 48 whole calendar months before the order's placed date, a tenure credit of 0.30 is added to the service-fee share refund; when it was enrolled at least 24 and fewer than 48 whole calendar months before, the credit is 0.15; otherwise, or when no membership is recorded on the order, there is no credit. The credit is added after the fee share is rounded to the cent and forms part of the refund, which as a whole never exceeds the service fee billed less the service fee already returned on the order.

Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date. Here the earlier date is the membership's enrolled date and the later date is the order's placed date.

## Questions answered

**Which dates are compared?** The enrolled date of the Cartwise+ Membership named on the order, and the date the order was placed. The date of the call plays no part.

**A membership enrolled on 10 June 2022 and an order placed on 10 June 2026 — which credit?** Forty-eight anniversaries of 10 June 2022 fall on or before 10 June 2026, so 48 whole months have passed: 0.30.

**The same membership, order placed on 9 June 2026?** Only 47 anniversaries have passed: 0.15.

**Enrolled on 10 June 2024, order placed on 9 June 2026?** Twenty-three whole months: no credit.

**Enrolled on 10 June 2024, order placed on 10 June 2026?** Exactly 24 whole months: 0.15.

**No membership recorded on the order?** No credit.

| Whole months from enrolled date to placed date | Tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 48 or more | 0.30 |
| 24 to 47 | 0.15 |
| Fewer than 24, or no membership recorded | None |
